latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "tianqi" skill for weather queries in Chinese.
- Answers weather, temperature, rain, wind, and short-range forecasts using wttr.in and Open-Meteo.
- Prefers Chinese place names, Chinese-language summaries, and Celsius temperatures.
- Uses wttr.in for quick text lookups, and Open-Meteo for structured forecast data or geocoding fallback.
- Provides tailored responses for ambiguous or colloquial location queries and gives concise daily/weekly weather updates.
